answer: Require every agent to lock a time-delayed stake before trading, like planting a grove where each tree must grow roots before it bears fruit. Reputation accrues only from work verified by independent peers, and a misbehaving identity forfeits its stake and history. Newcomers start in a shallow lagoon of low-value tasks and earn deeper access as their verified record grows, so no sonnet of sweet promises can shortcut the slow proof of honest work. Forging a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand lost deposits.
